researchDepth: Structured Family landscape and exact-proposition follow-up, not a formal systematic review. Access-limited findings are labelled; no clinical/practitioner recommendation.

entityReviews.constructReview: Behavior-specific favorable/unfavorable evaluation; distinct from evaluation of an object, belief truth, intention and action. Evaluative conditioning of an arbitrary stimulus does not establish change in the specified behavior attitude.
entityReviews.measurementReview: Use directly elicited behavior-specific valence, not an expectancy-times-value calculated index. Shared self-report and item wording require temporal alignment.
entityReviews.timeReview: Canonical minutes–hours onset/days–weeks change is not an empirically estimated universal lag; health intervention follow-up varies.
entityReviews.unresolved: Outcome/behavior correspondence and operational invariance across populations; canonical definition untouched.

entityReviews.constructReview: Multidimensional certainty/accessibility/stability/resistance profile, not favorable valence. Increasing certainty in an unfavorable attitude need not increase intention to perform a behavior.
entityReviews.measurementReview: A single attitude-certainty item does not measure every dimension of Attitude Strength. No whole-profile decrease/increase inferred.
entityReviews.timeReview: A within-session certainty difference is not demonstrated durable attitude stability or enduring resistance.
entityReviews.unresolved: Profile dimensions may dissociate; candidate-only boundary issue, not Driver-to-RDS reclassification.

entityReviews.constructReview: Confidence attached to a particular proposition, distinct from factual accuracy, general credulity and source trust. Keep the proposition referent fixed: confidence in a false claim versus its negation have opposite directions.
entityReviews.measurementReview: Perceived-truth ratings are defensible bounded indicators of belief confidence, not knowledge or calibrated probability. Metacognitive Confidence overlaps when explicitly about the same belief.
entityReviews.timeReview: Exposure studies support tested sessions/delays only; no lifetime belief change inferred.
entityReviews.unresolved: PSY-003/PSY-116 same-belief scope may be a duplicate representation; do not merge definitions or propagate both without reconciliation.

entityReviews.constructReview: Probability of an action producing a named outcome, not desirability, probability of completing the action, or reinforcement value. The outcome can be aversive.
entityReviews.measurementReview: A belief-based attitude index includes outcome expectancy by construction; compare independently measured attitude before interpreting an effect.
entityReviews.timeReview: Specify feedback/learning before subsequent probability judgment; theory alone supplies no causal lag.
entityReviews.unresolved: Reinforcement Expectancy combines probability and value; Observationally Learned Expectancy specifies acquisition route. Neither is automatically an independent cause of the broader construct.

entityReviews.constructReview: Desirability of a specified possible outcome, not probability of obtaining it or expected utility of an action. Food pleasantness may index a narrow outcome but not all motivational value.
entityReviews.measurementReview: Willingness to pay bundles resource constraints and trade-offs; consumption frequency is not a direct value score. Avoid formula-derived attitude double counting.
entityReviews.timeReview: Within-meal sensory-specific change is transient, not a durable change in abstract values.
entityReviews.unresolved: Canonical contextual meaning must be specified before transfer from food pleasantness to generic outcome valuation.

entityReviews.constructReview: Probability of completing a task/goal. Self-Efficacy concerns ability to execute an action under conditions; the two can coincide for a tightly specified success criterion but must not be declared identical.
entityReviews.measurementReview: Predicted success is direct; effort choice and persistence are outcomes/proxies. Incentives and motivation can contaminate can-do judgments.
entityReviews.timeReview: Feedback-related task expectancy is not a stable optimistic disposition; timing and task difficulty must align.
entityReviews.unresolved: No exact aligned feedback effect sufficiently extracted yet; causal isolation does not justify an edge.

entityReviews.constructReview: Judged pertinence to current goals/identity/situation, not stimulus salience, perceived argument quality, or mere exposure duration.
entityReviews.measurementReview: Attention/elaboration listed as indicators may also be downstream consequences; do not circularly measure relevance by its hypothesized effect.
entityReviews.timeReview: Proposed near-term versus distant policy applicability manipulates a situation; perceived relevance and processing must be separately checked.
entityReviews.unresolved: The 1981 experiment manipulates involvement and tests argument/source sensitivity; it does not directly establish every dimension of elaboration depth.

canonicalSourceReviews.finding: 204 experimental tests selected for successful cognition change support bounded attitude-to-intention causality in health contexts. Selection on manipulation success and bundled interventions limit generalization.
Theory/review distinguishes salient beliefs, outcome evaluations and global attitude; product-sum estimates are measurement models, not independent causal identification.

Two student studies test perceived argument-strength framing after counterarguing and attitude certainty. Study 1 lacks control; Study 2 adds control. Elaboration/need-for-cognition moderators measured, not randomized.
Need-for-cognition scale validation, not an experimental effect of relevance on elaboration or argument strength on belief.
Intended Fonagy/Allison article DOI is 10.1037/a0036505, not stored 10.1159/000366497. The intended work is a therapeutic theoretical review, not a general randomized epistemic-trust effect.
Named 1999 theory chapter could not be verified at the stored journal-article locator. Do not treat unresolved locator as accessed efficacy evidence.
Foundational self-efficacy synthesis is registered; exact action-outcome versus capability passages require further access. Not independently scored as reviewed causal evidence here.
Prospect-theory source cannot by its citation alone establish outcome valuation changing an independently measured behavior attitude.
Critical source-credibility review is not a substitute for exact belief-confidence endpoint verification.
Legacy citation must be reconciled before treating an inoculation source as evidence for a monotonic counterarguing-to-belief effect.
Organizational trust theory is not direct evidence for generic epistemic-trust effects on a specified factual proposition.
94-study framing synthesis reported no detected attitudes/intentions advantage, distinct from prevention-behavior results; erratum listed, not yet reconciled for effect extraction.
Science-misinformation correction synthesis reports nonsignificant average with interval spanning zero and heterogeneity. This is not equivalence evidence or proof every correction fails.
Flag overconfidence/calibration versus proposition confidence distinction; no new empirical extraction.
Self-consistency theory is not direct evidence that belief strength and metacognitive confidence are distinct manipulations.

existingReviews.rationale: Bounded health-attitude change evidence supports intention change; no action inference. Existing general source populations, timing and manipulation bundles need V1 specificity.
existingReviews.nullContrary: Successful-manipulation selection does not establish all attitude interventions succeed; mixed tasks and behavior endpoints not imported.

existingReviews.rationale: Attitude strength changes the consequence of valence; stronger negative attitude need not increase positive behavioral intention. Legacy record itself says moderation was flattened.
existingReviews.nullContrary: Certainty findings are conditional and not whole-profile intention effects.
existingReviews.proposal: Review edge-targeted moderation of REL-PSY-001 by PSY-002; no exact replacement asserted until independent strength-dimension manipulation and intention endpoint evidence are established.

existingReviews.rationale: Retain context-dependent sign in proposal; expectancy-value formula is not experimental causality. Outcome probability and valence must refer to the same salient outcome.
existingReviews.nullContrary: Belief-based and global attitude measures can diverge; scaling and salience limit the product-sum model.
existingReviews.proposal: PSY-004 may alter independently elicited PSY-001 for one specified action/outcome when outcome valuation and other salient beliefs are explicitly scoped; exclude calculated attitude indices as target evidence. RESEARCH_NEEDED.

existingReviews.rationale: Outcome value is not action attitude; no causal inference from using valuation as a component of an attitude estimator.
existingReviews.nullContrary: Probability, alternative outcomes and reference dependence prevent universal polarity.
existingReviews.proposal: PSY-005 may alter independently elicited PSY-001 for the specified behavior conditional on its believed connection to that outcome; preserve context-dependent sign and exclude formula-entailment. RESEARCH_NEEDED.

existingReviews.rationale: Involvement experiment gives mechanistic leverage but argument sensitivity is an indirect processing indicator. Registered need-for-cognition scale does not establish this exact causal edge.
existingReviews.nullContrary: Manipulated involvement must be distinguished from measured relevance; more relevance can motivate biased processing, not universally deeper valid elaboration.

existingReviews.rationale: Prior opinion and involvement change source-cue effects. Perceived-source manipulation checks and attitude outcomes do not automatically identify belief confidence causality.
existingReviews.nullContrary: Primary credibility experiments can show facilitated, inhibited or absent persuasion; do not transfer universal positive sign.
existingReviews.proposal: Scope PSY-113 to credibility relevant to the exact communicated claim and PSY-003 to confidence in that same claim, with prior belief/involvement and independent credibility measurement specified. Direction remains unresolved; no revision implemented.

existingReviews.rationale: Message-quality manipulation and its check are not an independently manipulated latent perceived-strength variable; opinion outcome is not always factual belief confidence.
existingReviews.nullContrary: Task-specific quality ratings may share evaluation method with belief ratings; reverse interpretation is possible.

existingReviews.rationale: Counterarguments against a message and confidence in one's original belief have different referents. One negative generic edge can encode the wrong sign.
existingReviews.nullContrary: Resistance can increase prior-attitude certainty under high elaboration while low-elaboration effects are undetected; certainty is not the entire attitude profile.
existingReviews.proposal: Separate research questions: counterarguing a specified message may reduce confidence in its conclusion; perceived successful resistance may change confidence in a prior opposing position. No pair of formal replacement edges or pathway is created.

existingReviews.rationale: Therapeutic epistemic-trust theory and organizational-trust theory do not identify a general causal increase in confidence in an arbitrary proposition; SRC166 DOI conflict compounds alignment risk.
existingReviews.nullContrary: Trust can permit belief revision downward as well as upward; willingness to learn is not unconditional credulity.

hypotheses.question: Additional exposure to the same claim changes subsequent belief confidence.
hypotheses.reason: Discovery path resolved to scoped REL-CAND-PSY-LAYER-0001, not an additional proposition. Accuracy task, claim plausibility and population boundaries remain explicit; human decision pending.

hypotheses.question: Correction detail reduces belief in the corrected false claim.
hypotheses.reason: Refutation package changes explanation, warning and sourcing together; cannot isolate quantity of detail. One-day versus week contrasts differ.

hypotheses.question: Exposure acts through PSY-067 Familiarity to increase belief.
hypotheses.reason: No pathway-specific transmitted effect or independently identified mediator extracted; reachability and fluency theory are insufficient.

hypotheses.question: Attitude strength moderates valence-to-intention.
hypotheses.reason: Dimension-specific strength versus valence must be independent; preserve REL-PSY-002 retype review as same shared question.

hypotheses.question: Success expectancy and self-efficacy may overlap under aligned task success criteria.
hypotheses.reason: Capability, opportunity and motivation can dissociate; identity not justified.

hypotheses.question: Belief Strength and Metacognitive Confidence may duplicate confidence in the same proposition.
hypotheses.reason: Canonical definitions overlap at aligned belief scope; require human boundary decision, not merger or an independently propagating edge.

hypotheses.question: Satiety changes valuation of a specified food outcome.
hypotheses.reason: Meal manipulation versus latent satiety, palatability versus possible-outcome value, and generic BIO definition need exact alignment; do not infer a universal value effect.

hypotheses.question: Outcome expectancy causes attitude because attitude score is the sum of expectancy × value.
hypotheses.reason: Mathematical score contribution is not independently identified causality; duplicate calculation must not propagate.

hypotheses.question: Favorable attitude is intention and therefore action.
hypotheses.reason: Evaluation, commitment and performed behavior are distinct.

hypotheses.question: Source credibility is the factual accuracy or confidence of every sourced belief.
hypotheses.reason: Source attribute, confidence and external truth criterion are different referents; no equivalence.

hypotheses.question: Performance feedback updates success expectancy.
hypotheses.reason: Search located mood/feedback and motivation studies, but exact feedback contrast and task-probability outcome not sufficiently extracted. No direction invented.

hypotheses.question: Incentive or institutional rule changes update action-outcome expectancy.
hypotheses.reason: Incentive value is not outcome probability; require actual contingency and expectancy measurement, not merely offered money.

hypotheses.question: Cultural context modifies source-credibility effects.
hypotheses.reason: Nationality is not an exact canonical Cultural moderator; no formal assertion from a cross-cultural feedback comparison.

hypotheses.question: Relevance causes elaboration because elaboration was the relevance measure.
hypotheses.reason: Circular operationalization; independent constructs must be measured separately.

hypotheses.question: Noise, disaster or social/institutional shock changes a specified behavior attitude.
hypotheses.reason: Screening mostly found risk perceptions and observational beliefs, not temporally identified exact attitude change. No external Family audit or generic shock edge.

hypotheses.question: Increasing any attitude-strength dimension uniformly increases positive intention.
hypotheses.reason: Strongly unfavorable attitude can oppose the behavior; strength is not signed valence.
